latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Convert YouTube videos to TikTok-ready clips.

- Upload a YouTube video (or supported file) and describe how you want it edited for TikTok.
- Automatic 9:16 vertical cropping; outputs high-quality 1080p MP4.
- No install required; all processing is cloud-based with brief, guided setup.
- Supports credits system with 100 free credits (via anonymous token).
- Clear mapping of user prompts to actions (export, credits, upload, state, edit).
- Helpful error handling and workflow tips included for best results.
